documents.textLong:
IACE only offers short courses that address issue-specific industry concerns that require a direct, decisive, and focused answer. The various short courses offered are designed to introduce, enhance, update, and further expand the client’s knowledge on different categories namely; Accounting, Banking and Finance, Human Resource, Administration and Management, Leadership, Education and Training, Insurance and Healthcare, Engineering and Construction, Information and Communication Technology, Art and Media, Sales and Marketing, and Legal.

These short courses usually have duration of 1 week (at minimum) to 1 month (at maximum) depending on the schedule of availability of the client and their preferred program content. All lectures would be conducted at the IACE classrooms.

Certificates would be given to participants upon completion of the course

Below are the short courses that we offer
